integrity: Analytic proof and standalone numerical checker included; finite checks are not substituted for infinite limit proof. All sources credited; no independent validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: The result is an a-down-to-zero equivalent for the exact even standing Gaussian cat; it does not address general phase, squeezing, noise, multimode states, or independent priority.
title: Sharp near-vacuum Wigner-negativity asymptotic for an even Gaussian cat
